items.title: Replace all koala/Koala/KOALA with lattice/Lattice/LATTICE in CHANGELOG.md
items.context: Full de-koala of CHANGELOG.md: version titles (Koala 0.3.x -> Lattice 0.3.x), product-name prose (Koala -> Lattice), koala-lab -> lattice-lab, and ALL historical technical tokens (@koala-agent -> @lattice-agent, koala commands -> lattice, .koala/ -> .lattice/, bin/koala.js -> bin/lattice.js, koala.config -> lattice.config). Case-preserving substitution. User accepts the history becomes non-literal. Scope is CHANGELOG.md only.
items.userSees: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns 0 (down from 49); CHANGELOG reads fully Lattice-branded

happy.desc: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns 0 matches (was 49) -> proves all occurrences replaced; WHY: core requirement that every koala variant is gone

grep -c Lattice CHANGELOG.md shows replacements present AND case-preserving: Koala->Lattice in titles, koala->lattice in tokens, KOALA->LATTICE in constants -> correct case mapping; WHY: ensures substitution preserved original casing

diff of CHANGELOG.md shows koala-lab->lattice-lab, @koala-agent->@lattice-agent, .koala/->..lattice/, bin/koala.js->bin/lattice.js, koala.config->lattice.config -> all historical technical tokens converted; WHY: technical tokens are the highest-risk substitution targets

edge.desc: grep for mixed-case edge patterns (kOaLa, KOALA_, _koala) in CHANGELOG.md -> 0 matches; WHY: catches partial/unusual casing that a naive s/koala/lattice/gi might miss or that might not have been covered

CHANGELOG.md markdown renders valid: all headers (##) have correct format, no orphaned backticks or broken inline-code fences after substitution -> markdown structure preserved; WHY: find-replace inside backtick-delimited tokens could break markdown syntax

line count of CHANGELOG.md before vs after is identical (479 lines) -> no accidental line insertion/deletion during substitution; WHY: ensures the edit was purely in-place replacement, not structural modification

adversarial.desc: manually re-insert a single koala token (e.g. koala-lab) into CHANGELOG.md then run git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md -> returns 1 match proving the grep check is sensitive enough to catch a single residual; WHY: validates the acceptance grep is not silently passing

insert a Unicode homoglyph koala (e.g. using Cyrillic a: koаla) into CHANGELOG.md then run git grep -i koala -> returns 0 (grep does not catch it) but a visual inspection note is warranted; WHY: adversarial check that homoglyph bypass is acknowledged as out-of-scope for ASCII grep

items.title: Acceptance: zero koala in CHANGELOG, build and validate green
items.context: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns nothing; npm run build exits 0; the lattice validate suite stays all-green (CHANGELOG is docs, excluded from the koala-residue gate, no test impact).
items.userSees: 0 koala in CHANGELOG; npm run build exit 0; lattice validate all-green

happy.desc: npm run build exits 0 after CHANGELOG.md rebrand -> build unaffected by docs-only change; WHY: confirms no build regression from the substitution
lattice validate returns all-green after CHANGELOG.md rebrand -> validation suite still passes; WHY: confirms no validation regression
git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns empty (exit code 1) -> zero residual koala strings; WHY: the primary acceptance criterion stated in the story

edge.desc: CHANGELOG.md has no broken markdown headers (every line starting with # has valid header syntax) and no orphaned code fences after substitution -> structural integrity preserved; WHY: edge case where replacement inside markdown formatting could corrupt document structure
git diff --stat shows only CHANGELOG.md modified (no other files touched) -> scope confined to single file; WHY: ensures the change did not leak outside the declared scope

adversarial.desc: run the koala-residue gate (if it exists) and confirm CHANGELOG.md is still excluded from it -> gate exclusion unchanged; WHY: if someone accidentally removed the CHANGELOG exclusion from the gate, this change could trigger a false positive

after the rebrand, run git grep -i koala across the entire repo and confirm CHANGELOG.md does NOT appear in results -> proves CHANGELOG is now fully clean even if the gate does not check it; WHY: adversarial completeness check beyond the gate exclusion
